div.div:
apply_wizard_batch
• may_execute_wizard_command(): the batch context
• for each item: refresh_checks() (new memo, new checker, re-snapshot) → overwrite the stored
statement's type and data → is_wizard_batch_command_create() → apply_one(item.type)
• restore the statement

div.div:
an apply_* function: validate_->may_execute_wizard_command() (the per-command checks, in order; the first failure throws) → change the graph with builder_t (new vertices get
created_by_wizard) → refresh_live_and_hashed(vd_aggregate) after structural edits

closed versions: a root version at or before last_hashed. The validator protects them; the apply_* functions assume the checks passed. A batch refreshes the checker between commands
so the next one sees the new seal.
